vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: shelter
Version: 1.0.2

The skill bundle is benign. The `SKILL.md` defines a financial coaching agent that interacts with a specified API (`https://api.shelterfinance.com/agent`) using `curl` and an environment variable `SHELTER_API_KEY`. The `install-skill.js` and `uninstall-skill.js` scripts perform standard local file system operations to copy the skill's definition files (`SKILL.md`, `references/`) into the expected `.claude/skills/shelter` directory and remove them upon uninstallation. There is no evidence of prompt injection, unauthorized data exfiltration, malicious execution, or persistence mechanisms beyond the intended skill installation.

llm.summary: The skill's files, runtime instructions, and requested secret line up with a read-only financial-data adapter; nothing requested is disproportionate to that purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description describe a read-only financial advisor and the skill only requires a single API key (SHELTER_API_KEY) and curl. The declared requirements are consistent with calling a remote agent API that returns computed financial insights.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains only curl-based calls to a Shelter API and guidance to pick endpoints; it does not instruct reading unrelated files or credentials. Minor mismatch: SKILL.md refers to an optional SHELTER_API_URL variable (with a default) but the registry does not declare that env var — this is benign but worth confirming. Also there are inconsistent domain strings across files (shelterfinance.com vs shelter.money) that should be verified before use.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No remote downloads or installers; the included install-skill.js copies SKILL.md and references/ into ~/.claude/skills (or a project-level path). postinstall runs a local install script when installed from npm — expected behavior but note it writes files into the user's home directory.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only one credential (SHELTER_API_KEY) is required and is the declared primary credential. No other secrets or system config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true, does not modify other skills, and only places its own files under the user's skills directory. Uninstall script removes that directory. This is a normal installation pattern.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and implements a read-only connector to a Shelter agent API, but do these quick checks before installing: 1) Verify the vendor and repository (npm package and GitHub repo referenced) and prefer installing from the official source you trust; 2) Confirm the correct API base URL/domain (SKILL.md, README, and package.json use different domains: shelterfinance.com vs shelter.money) and validate TLS/host identity; 3) Ensure any SHELTER_API_KEY you create is scoped and revocable and that the app's docs truly restrict write/money-movement operations; 4) Be aware the npm postinstall script will copy files into ~/.claude/skills — inspect install-skill.js locally if you want to confirm behavior; 5) If you need higher assurance, contact the support address in README or check the public repository and issues to confirm the project’s legitimacy.
